headline: Bangladeshi student killed in Cyprus after bus argument
summary: A 22-year-old student, Shahriar Ahmed Iman, was murdered by a foreign national who later staged a fake kidnapping for ransom
details: A 22-year-old Bangladeshi student, Shahriar Ahmed Iman, was found dead in Larnaca, Cyprus. The investigation into his disappearance has now turned into a murder case after a suspect was arrested.

The suspect, a 22-year-old foreign national, confessed to the killing. He led police to a location near the Kofinou immigrant reception center and a local slaughterhouse, where the body was recovered from under grass and weeds.

According to police, the suspect lured Shahriar from his home in Oroklini with a job offer. He then took him to a secluded area in Kofinou and killed him by stabbing him multiple times in the neck and back, and strangling him.

After the murder, the suspect stole Shahriar's phone and staged a fake kidnapping to extort money from the family. He contacted the student's father, who lives in Greece, demanding 10,000 euros and later 25,000 euros in ransom.

Investigation reveals that the conflict began five days before the murder, following an argument on a bus. The suspect became enraged by a comment made by Shahriar, and later used the job offer as a trap.
The suspect has been arrested and was scheduled to appear in the Larnaca District Court for a remand hearing. Forensic teams are continuing to collect evidence from the crime scene.

headline_marked: Viral albino buffalo ‘Donald Trump’ [[moved to BLRI for genetic research]]
headline: Viral albino buffalo ‘Donald Trump’ moved to BLRI for genetic research
summary: The rare animal, which gained widespread social media attention, will now permanently reside at the Bangladesh Livestock Research Institute in Savar.
details: The rare albino buffalo known as “Donald Trump,” which attracted widespread attention in Bangladesh and abroad, has been transferred to the Bangladesh Livestock Research Institute (BLRI) in Savar for scientific research.
Following a directive from the Ministry of Fisheries and Livestock, the animal was formally handed over to BLRI by the Mirpur National Zoo on Sunday.
BLRI authorities have formed a 13-member committee to oversee the buffalo, and the animal is currently undergoing a mandatory 14-day preliminary quarantine.
Chief Scientific Officer Dr Gautam Kumar Deb stated that the research will focus on the buffalo's genetic and production potential due to its unique and attractive breed.
The buffalo was originally reared by Ziauddin Mridha of Rabeya Agro Farm in Narayanganj and was later purchased for Tk 3.85 lakh for sacrificial purposes.
Due to its viral fame on social media, authorities took custody of it on security grounds, leading to its journey from the Keraniganj Police Station to the National Zoo and finally to BLRI.
caption:
A viral albino buffalo named 'Donald Trump' is now a subject of scientific study.

The rare albino buffalo known as “Donald Trump,” which attracted widespread attention in Bangladesh and abroad, has been transferred to the Bangladesh Livestock Research Institute (BLRI) in Savar for scientific research.

Following a directive from the Ministry of Fisheries and Livestock, the animal was formally handed over to BLRI by the Mirpur National Zoo on Sunday.

BLRI authorities have formed a 13-member committee to oversee the buffalo, and the animal is currently undergoing a mandatory 14-day preliminary quarantine.

Chief Scientific Officer Dr Gautam Kumar Deb stated that the research will focus on the buffalo's genetic and production potential due to its unique and attractive breed.

The buffalo was originally reared by Ziauddin Mridha of Rabeya Agro Farm in Narayanganj and was later purchased for Tk 3.85 lakh for sacrificial purposes.

Due to its viral fame on social media, authorities took custody of it on security grounds, leading to its journey from the Keraniganj Police Station to the National Zoo and finally to BLRI.
